item.title: SKIP LOCKED vs CAS in PostgreSQL
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Eight workers poll the same jobs table. Each job must be processed by exactly one of them. Two PostgreSQL tools solve this, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and compare-and-swap (CAS), and on the same workload one claimed every job it tried for while the other lost most of its attempts.

item.title: Fixed Window vs Sliding Window vs Token Bucket
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Say a limiter allows 100 requests per minute. At 11:59:59 a user sends 100. At 12:00:01 they send 100 more. That’s 200 requests in 2 seconds, and one common implementation lets all of them through.
